scope: Scalar READ widths, integral bases, quoted STRING fields and ordered dynamic formats

reference_basis.documented: Input widths, integral bases 2..16, ignored REAL/BOOLEAN second formats and STRING quote mode 0/2
reference_basis.uncertainty: The quoted-STRING example and prose leave wrapper retention unclear; dynamic expressions, zero defaults, whitespace and escape rules are chosen Pythonic policies

implementation_choices.formats: At most two INTEGER expressions: width 0..254; integral base 0 or 2..16; STRING mode 0/2; REAL/BOOLEAN second value evaluated and ignored
implementation_choices.order: For each item capture the target, evaluate width then second format once, validate formats, then continue; retain concrete references/capacities; all captures precede the outer callback
implementation_choices.fields: Width zero retains token/remainder rules; positive widths consume exact characters on one physical line with no cross-line fill; short fields consume the available remainder and fail
implementation_choices.numbers: Python int(field,base)/float(field), with surrounding whitespace allowed; documented BOOLEAN abbreviations plus existing 1/0; preserve checked storage domains
implementation_choices.quotes: STRING mode 2 strips wrappers, decodes doubled apostrophes, preserves interior blanks and allows empty contents; width zero stops at closing quote, fixed widths require whitespace suffix; decoded contents bounded to 254 before truncation
implementation_choices.metadata: Optional concrete per-target format_specifiers tuples; plain targets retain prior shape; source reports include literal formats or dynamic expression positions; formats participate in effects and FOR checks
implementation_choices.typed_adapters: Host/JSON values are already decoded; widths, bases and quoting are metadata, while ordinary storage/response validation remains
implementation_choices.failures: Validate metadata before consumption, formats before later target effects, each decoded field before later input and the complete response before stores; no rewind; ordinary cleanup

retained_boundaries: No FILE/device, binary input, native buffering/status/window-error behavior or implicit stdin
Existing active-counter, initialization, ownership, POSITION, CONFIG, numeric and capacity protections
Strict remains future work; no native compiler/controller execution claim
